news.title: Tekmetric Names Kristen Young as First CFO
Tekmetric Appoints Kristen Young as Chief Financial Officer

bullets: Directly lead multiple Directors/Group PMs and indirectly oversee the entire PM organization.
Recruit, coach, and mentor a high-performing PM team with a strong emphasis on accountability, customer insight, and product excellence.
Establish consistent product management standards, operating rhythms, rituals, and evaluation frameworks across teams.
Lead Strategic Product Initiatives : Drive the planning and execution of product initiatives from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with business goals and market trends.
Become and expert in the Auto Repair Industry : Develop a deep understanding of the Auto Repair domain in order to best identify new product opportunities for our core users.
Lead Key AI Product Initiatives: Combine a deep understanding of the problem space with generative AI solutions to help customers do their jobs better and faster.
User-Centric Research : Deeply understand our core users’ JTBD, concept testing, and usability testing into an iterative development process.
Collaborate Across Teams : Work with design, engineering, product marketing, and sales teams to align on product vision, strategy, go-to-market plans, pricing, packaging, and…
